description: Injected taps on the persistent Keyboard control show, dismiss, and reopen wvkbd; the terminal resizes above it.
provenance_note: Operator-declared metadata does not prove that footage shows a real touch.

site_assets.video_transform: 180 degree rotation and full-to-limited range conversion; original camera clip retained
site_assets.screenshot_source: grim on the physical board, transferred over serial

review.video_probe: H.264, yuv420p, limited range, 1920x1080, 30 fps, 22.000 seconds, 660 frames
review.visual_review: Reviewed camera frames near 3, 6, 10, and 16 seconds. The portrait panel and persistent Apps/Windows/Keyboard/System controls are visible, but camera glare and the oblique view obscure the lower keyboard area; screen.png clearly shows the keyboard and hidden.png clearly shows the dismissed state.
review.interaction_state: Injected uinput taps showed, dismissed, and reopened wvkbd; the camera clip proves the physical panel display, not a real finger touch.
